description: This Java source file defines the class NonMonotonicSequenceException, which represents an exception thrown when a sequence of numbers is not monotonically increasing or decreasing, optionally strictly. It extends MathIllegalNumberException and includes details about the sequence's direction, strictness, the index of the problematic value, and the previous value.

classes.name: NonMonotonicSequenceException
classes.description: Represents an exception for non-monotonic sequences, indicating whether the sequence should be increasing or decreasing, and whether it should be strictly monotonic.

methods.name: NonMonotonicSequenceException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the wrong value, previous value, index, direction, and strictness.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the sequence (increasing or decreasing).

methods.name: getStrict
methods.description: Indicates whether the sequence was required to be strictly monotonic.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the value that caused the exception.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous value in the sequence.
